purpose: Give the active Song one real, bounded, deterministic AI-off creative suggestion surface so the artist can ask for a small, adjacent, or deliberately contrasting experiment while locking dimensions they do not want varied. This establishes a truthful suggestion object for later Not Now/suppression work without inventing a task system, Artist World personalization, provider authority or DAW mutation.

lineage.outcome: The artist can ask the active Song for one bounded creative experiment without requiring AI, a provider, a DAW mutation, or false personalization.
lineage.capability: Deterministic local Song suggestion with explicit creative distance and artist-owned dimension locks
enables: REQ-SCOPE-097 durable Not Now over real suggestions
later controlled randomize and reversible suppression

why_now: PR #72 repaired the coarse construction dependency that incorrectly required all cross-cutting UX-01 work to finish before SONG-01, while CONV-01 still requires both UX and Song. Canonical SCOPE_LEDGER reconciliation shows REQ-SCOPE-097 Not Now needs real N0TE suggestions/jobs, and REQ-SCOPE-140 under SONG-01 owns that creative suggestion lifecycle. Current main has template/recipe planning foundations but no consumer Familiar/Adjacent/Wildcard suggestion surface or durable suggestion object. This bounded slice creates the smallest truthful prerequisite instead of manufacturing fake deferred tasks.

implementation_contract.familiar_semantics: Smaller move around the current Song context only; never claim familiarity with artist taste without Artist World evidence.
implementation_contract.adjacent_semantics: Vary one unlocked creative dimension while preserving the others as much as practical.
implementation_contract.wildcard_semantics: Offer a larger deliberate contrast in one unlocked dimension as a reversible experiment, not a diagnosis.
implementation_contract.lock_semantics: Every artist-locked dimension is excluded from suggestion selection; all locked fails closed.
implementation_contract.result_lifetime: Ephemeral browser/runtime suggestion result for this increment; stable semantic key exists internally for later bounded deferral/suppression contracts.
implementation_contract.authority: Suggestion choice grants no action authority, execution eligibility, provider access or DAW mutation permission.

completion_proof: the active Song exposes exactly one Suggest something consumer card without editing the monolithic ConsumerShell implementation
FAMILIAR, ADJACENT and WILDCARD have materially distinct bounded semantics
artist-selected dimension locks are respected exactly and all-locks fails closed
the same Song/session/distance/locks/variation request returns the same deterministic local suggestion
suggestion generation performs no canonical Song/Session/Evidence/Activity/Attention/Operation writes
the consumer path uses exact Host, Origin, CSRF, one-shot action and active-Song binding protections
visible copy says no AI/provider was called, no project was changed, and the prompt is not a diagnosis of what the Song needs
internal semantic suggestion keys and Song/session IDs are not exposed in normal rendered markup
suggestion result is ephemeral and does not survive shell relaunch
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Linux, Windows and macOS at the exact implementation head
